  "If melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin of 1–3 mm to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as those on the face, acral sites, or genitalia.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible."
